Builder value: this is model choice becoming a system instead of a guess. Fewer wasted tokens, faster iteration, better output for the job you're actually doing.

Try this: next session, pick your model on purpose, light tier for quick edits, heavy tier for the hard reasoning pass. Notice the difference.
